gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma per 2021 WHO classification at first progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Onfekafusp alfa (other names: L19TNF): Patients will be treated with 10 µg/kg L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5, and on Days 22, 24 and 26

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Open label phase I study in subjects with glioblastoma at first progression to explore two different administration schedules of lomustine for the combination with L19TNF (ARM 1 and ARM 2).

role_evidence.quote: Patients will be treated in escalating cohorts of 6 patients with 10 µg/kg L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5, and on Days 22, 24 and 26 and lomustine at different doses on Day 1 and Day 22

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational antibody-cytokine fusion protein (L19 anti-EDB-fibronectin antibody fused to TNF); immunostimulatory

role_evidence.quote: to explore two different administration schedules of lomustine for the combination with L19TNF (ARM 1 and ARM 2)
Arm 1: Patients will be treated in escalating cohorts of 6 patients with lomustine at different doses (60 mg/m2 and 75 mg/m2) on Day 1 and Day 22

flag.reason: Lomustine is given in both arms (rule 3, soc_backbone) but its dose and schedule (fractionated vs single dose after L19TNF priming) are the object of investigation (rule 6). Coded rule 6.

source_quote.quote: MGMT promotor methylation status known or tumor tissue for analysis available.

flag.reason: Known MGMT status (or tissue) is required for entry, but no particular status is required; could be coded exploratory_correlative.

coder_notes: Two experimental arms differ only in lomustine dose/schedule relative to L19TNF; no control arm. L19TNF (onfekafusp alfa) is the only investigational agent. Lead sponsor Philogen S.p.A. (industry by [CODE]).
